dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, there's a race at the university next month. Let's run!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðɛrz ə ˈreɪs ət ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ. ˈlɛts ˈrʌn!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me? You're a better runner. You run faster than me.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː? jʊr ə ˈbɛtər ˈrʌnər. juː ˈrʌn ˈfæstər ðən miː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My speed is good, but you run more easily. You never look tired!
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈspiːd ɪz ˈɡʊd, bʌt juː ˈrʌn ˈmɔːr ˈiːzəli. juː ˈnɛvər ˈlʊk ˈtaɪərd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's because I run more slowly than you!
dialogue.reading: ðæts bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈrʌn ˈmɔːr ˈsloʊli ðən juː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Don't worry. It isn't a marathon. It's a short race.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ɪt ˈɪzənt ə ˈmærəθɑːn. ɪts ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈreɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. But I need to practice harder.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. bʌt aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈpræktɪs ˈhɑːrdər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! And after the race, let's eat ice cream!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ˈæftər ðə ˈreɪs, ˈlɛts ˈiːt ˈaɪs ˌkriːm!
